research.searchCoverage: Bounded review on 2026-09-13 of official Booqable API v4 authentication and resource docs, company identity (Leeuwarden, Netherlands), and targeted incident/breach searches. No confirmed unresolved Booqable platform compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Booqable API v4 endpoint, Bearer access-token authentication, company-slug host, and current-company/customer/order/product-group reads were confirmed on 2026-09-13. Company identity is Booqable Rental Software, headquartered in Leeuwarden, Netherlands, with a global rental-software product. Targeted searches for Booqable security breach/incident/data leak on 2026-09-13 did not surface a confirmed unresolved platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
